summary.text: Edward Lee, a Republican candidate and longtime independent political activist, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 36 to Diana Moreno.
He describes himself as having organized cross-partisan candidate forums and debates in New York City.

paragraphs.text: Lee says he has been a political activist for over 30 years and that in 2022, 2024 and 2026 he gathered candidates across party lines at a project he founded, unifiedplatformusa.com, to document areas of agreement among them. He says he has organized what he describes as New York City's only third-party and independent candidate debates.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as activist. He was the Republican candidate in 2026; the Republican primary was canceled and he advanced without appearing on the ballot.
He received 15.1% of the vote to Diana Moreno's 84.7%, according to unofficial results reported by Ballotpedia and Wikipedia.
